subject: VPC/On‑Prem Data Playbook: retention, PII, and hosting constraints
body_summary: External requests alignment on mutual action plan covering VPC vs on‑prem options, retention policy, and PII handling. Internal team proposes playbook draft, technical constraints, and assigns owners to close by early May.
messages:
From: Michael Andrews <michael.andrews@finexahealth.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finexahealth.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick alignment — deployment options & data handling needs

Hi Ava / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed we need a short, actionable MAP that clarifies: 1) whether Finexa customer data can be hosted in Redwood’s hosted environment or requires a VPC/hosted-dedicated pool; 2) on‑prem deployment feasibility (timeline & constraints); 3) retention windows for logs, embeddings, and full request payloads; and 4) PII handling and redaction approaches.

Attached is Finexa’s security questionnaire (partial) and an initial list of legal/regulatory constraints for the pilot. Our target is to finalize technical commitments and an SOW by the first week of May so procurement can start.

Can we set a short checkpoint this week? Key asks from our side: SOC2 evidence, retention default, and whether you support tenant-isolation (VPC) for token-level logs.

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Andrews
Director, Platform Security
Finexa Health
Attachments: Finexa_Security_Questions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Andrews <michael.andrews@finexahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick alignment — deployment options & data handling needs

Hi Michael —

Appreciate the clear list. I’ve pulled together a very short playbook draft and a proposed 30/60/90 mutual action timeline to keep things scannable. Proposed 30‑minute checkpoint: Tue Apr 13 10:00am PT — will that work for you? If not, alternate slots Wed afternoon available.

High-level answers up front:
- Hosting: We can support both Hosted (standard Redwood API) and VPC (dedicated network + tenant isolation). On‑prem is possible as an engagement with timeline and packaging constraints (see playbook).
- Retention: default ephemeral token cache + 30d logs; we can offer custom retention SLAs for Dedicated/VPC contracts.
- PII: we support configurable PII redaction at ingest, metadata-only embeddings, and a host-side minimization flag.

I’ve attached the playbook (VPC_OnPrem_Playbook_v0.3.xlsx) and a draft MAP_timeline_20270411.docx with owners suggested. For SOC2, I’m adding Marissa and Karthik to help validate the evidence we can share.

Agenda for the checkpoint (15–20 minutes):
- Confirm deployment mode required for pilot (Hosted vs VPC vs On‑Prem)
- Agree retention windows for logs vs embeddings
- PII handling options and acceptable controls
- Next steps: SOW timing and document ownership

If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and the short pre-read.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: VPC_OnPrem_Playbook_v0.3.xlsx; MAP_timeline_20270411.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Andrews <michael.andrews@finexahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick alignment — deployment options & data handling needs

Ava / team —

Following up with technical constraints and proposed defaults (keeping it succinct so the security team can digest quickly):

1) VPC vs Hosted:
- Hosted (multi-tenant): easiest & fastest to run; acceptable for pseudonymized data and low-regulated workloads.
- VPC (dedicated infra in our cloud region): supports tenant-level network restrictions, private peering, and isolated storage — recommended if Finexa must avoid any multi-tenant exposure.
- On‑Prem: we can offer a packaged on‑prem appliance but expect a 10–12 week delivery window for packaging, validation, and customer infra validation. On‑prem also carries higher operational fees and a minimum committed capacity (reserved GPUs).

2) Retention defaults (proposed):
- KV / prefix caches: ephemeral — immediate eviction after session end unless caching explicitly requested.
- Inference logs (debug + request metadata): default 30 days for hosted; configurable to 90/180/365 for VPC/Enterprise contracts.
- Embeddings / derived vectors: treated as customer data — retention configurable; default retained 30 days unless customer requests persistent storage for similarity search.
- Full request payloads (raw text): default 7 days for hosted debugging; for VPC, can be set to 0 days (not stored) or archived per customer SLA.

3) PII handling:
- We provide ingest-time PII redaction (configurable rules + custom regex), token-level masking, and an SDK hook for local client-side redaction before sending.
- Note: PII redaction is best-effort; for regulated PHI/PII workloads we recommend VPC + on‑prem evaluation to minimize surface area.

Action items I propose (ownership & rough due dates):
- K1: Produce a technical appendix that maps Finexa questionnaire items to Redwood controls (owner: karthik.iyer; due: 2027-04-15)
- A1: Finalize playbook and MAP timeline with commercial terms (owner: ava.chen; due: 2027-04-14)
- M1: Validate SOC2 evidence package and what we can share (owner: marissa.cole; due: 2027-04-15)

I’ll join the checkpoint; I can present the appendix and run through the on‑prem timelines.

—Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Andrews <michael.andrews@finexahealth.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, security@finexahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick alignment — deployment options & data handling needs

Thanks — that level of detail is helpful. A few clarifications before the checkpoint:

1) Retention split: we need persistent embeddings for our similarity index (customer-controlled) but logs must be capped at 90 days max for the pilot. Can you confirm that for VPC we can set embeddings to 365d and logs to 90d?
2) SOC2: procurement requires the SOC2 report and the control mapping — can Marissa share what’s releasable and whether an NDA is needed for the full report?
3) On‑prem: the 10–12 week estimate is acceptable if we can get a commitment to start packaging by mid‑April. That will let us align internal change windows.

We are aiming to sign the SOW and have provisioning started by May 5. If Redwood can commit to the VPC retention SLAs and provide the SOC2 mapping by Apr 15, procurement will fast-track the SOW.

I’ll be on the Tue Apr 13 10:00am PT call.

Best,
Michael

Attachments: Finexa_Security_Questions_v1_filled.xlsx (updated answers)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Andrews <michael.andrews@finexahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick alignment — deployment options & data handling needs — checkpoint notes & owners

Michael / Team —

Thanks for the call this morning — quick written checkpoint to capture decisions and owners so nothing slips.

Decisions (agreed):
- Pilot deployment mode: VPC (dedicated infra) — Finexa requires tenant isolation for pilot.
- Embeddings: persistent storage OK for similarity index; target retention for pilot set to 365 days.
- Inference logs: pilot retention set to 90 days for VPC.
- Full request payloads: configured to 0 days (not stored) unless debugging requested (debug logs retained for up to 7 days on a case-by-case basis).
- PII: enable ingest-time PII redaction and SDK pre-send hooks; recommend additional application-layer redaction on Finexa side for PHI.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- A1: Ava — finalize MAP timeline and commercial note (RDW commitments for retention + VPC details). Due: 2027-04-14. (Attachment: MAP_timeline_20270411.docx)
- K1: Karthik — technical appendix mapping questionnaire -> controls; include on‑prem packaging ETA and ops runbook. Due: 2027-04-15. (Attachment: VPC_OnPrem_Playbook_v0.3.xlsx)
- M1: Marissa — confirm SOC2 evidence package (what we can share without NDA) and prepare control mapping doc. Due: 2027-04-15. (Attachment: Finexa_SOC2_questions_filled.pdf)
- A2: Ava — send SOW draft for review and DocuSign route (target to get signature by 2027-05-05). Due: 2027-04-20.

Next checkpoint: Fri 2027-04-16 09:00am PT (15 min) — focus: SOC2 deliverables and SOW readiness.

Links & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxyzPlaybook (playbook & MAP timeline); HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/DEAL-8931

Thanks — I’ll upload the updated playbook and the MAP timeline to the Drive and share the DocuSign link once the SOW draft is ready.

Cheers,
